(1) The most recent list found is "Truflo New Price List 05-02-26" (effective 5 Feb 2026; SWR + lead-free uPVC only, no CPVC), but only as a third-party Scribd upload (scribd.com/document/1005821279), which could not be opened. (2) truflopipes.com/erp/ajax.php shows MRPs per item code, but it states no effective date and gives two different MRPs for the same codes (e.g. CP1103015 SDR 11 15 mm × 3 m: 310 and 363), so it was not used. (3) The official PDFs found (w.e.f. 01.10.2021 and 24.08.2022, hosted on imimg.com) are too old to use.
IMAGES (added 25 Oct 2026): each product uses the main image of its own truflopipes.com product page.

Pipes are sold per length (unit "length"). Truflo lists them per piece. Lengths differ between variants (SDR 13.5 has 3 m and 5 m), so altUnit is left null and the length is a variant attribute. SDR 11 also has 5 m and 6 m length pages, but only 15 mm and 50 mm item codes were confirmed for 5 m, so only the 3 m length is loaded.

HSN 39172390 is the code shown on Truflo CPVC pipe and fitting pages, and on the concealed-valve page. The ball valve uses 8481 (valves) from the README table, because its own page HSN was not confirmed. GST 18% is believed but not confirmed. The shop's accountant must confirm both.

Reducer and Reducer Tee: Truflo lists 15 rows each, 20×15 to 50×40 mm, which is every run × branch combination of the six sizes. One Truflo listing page labels a few reducer-tee rows differently (25×15 vs 25×20), so check against the physical stock.

Brass Elbow 90°: 15×15, 20×15, 20×20, 25×25 and 32×32 were seen in two separate reads. 25×15 and 25×20 were seen in only one read of the product page (item codes CF24025015 and CF24025020). Verify these two before selling.
Pressure ratings: Hindware's CPVC page labels the low-temperature column 27 °C in one table and 23 °C in another. 27 °C is used here.

Truflo item codes were seen on the official pages and can be used to match a future price list. Pipes: CP11<len><size>, e.g. CP1103015 = SDR 11 3 m 15 mm. CP13<len><size> = SDR 13.5. Fittings: Coupler CF01, Elbow 90 CF02, Bend 45 CF03, Tee CF05, Reducer Tee CF06, End Cap CF08, Union CF14, Reducer CF15, Brass Elbow CF24, Brass Tee CF25, MABT CF26, FABT CF27 (+ size digits, e.g. CF02000015). Ball valve CEBV0100<size>. Concealed valves CECVQTT020 / CECVQTR020 / CECVFTT020 / CECVFTT025. UPVC MABT UF22000015–UF22000050. Note: the Elbow 90 product page shows the CF01 codes by mistake. CF01 is the coupler.
Manufacturer legal entity not confirmed from an official source in this run. "Truflo by Hindware" is the brand, and Truflo's 2023 corporate brochure calls itself part of the Somany Impresa Group.
